text:
sam_sales: Quick sync — Sentinel RFI: final checks before we send. Key asks from procurement: licensing model (metered vs seat), reserved-capacity discounts, BAA/HIPAA, data residency (EU-only option), POC timeline (2-week), and attachments: capability matrix + perf evals. I'm attaching the draft. Need decisions by EOD PST.

maya_soleng: Got it. Licensing: we support metered + reserved (3/6/12mo) with tiered discounts. I'll draft wording for the RFI — include sample pricing bands. @sam_sales do we want to offer a trial credit for the POC?

jonas_infra: For POC infra: Dedicated pool is available for 2wks. Need customer CIDR, VPC peering, and a short maintenance window for initial kernel tuning. Ops runbook: upload scheduled. If they need on-prem, we need lead time 6 weeks.

nina_security: HIPAA/BAA: we can sign BAA for Private/Dedicated. For hosted, need data processing addendum + customer controls. SOC2 Type II available — I'll prepare redacted copy. KMS/HSM: supported via customer-managed keys (BYOK).

legal-bot: Reminder: external sharing of SOC2 report requires CISO approval. Use internal ticket #PROD-753 to track.

maya_soleng: POC acceptance criteria (draft):
```
- Perf: 95th p99 token latency <= 350ms at sustained 500 qps
- Accuracy: baseline eval set F1 >= 0.78
- Stability: no more than 1% 5xx rate over 24h
- Security: VPC peering + kms + audit logs enabled
```

sam_sales: Flags from customer: wants price in USD with egress estimates, and an option for private deployment. Also asks for signed NDAs and timeline for SOC2. Can someone confirm calendar availability for walkthrough next Tue 10am PT?

maya_soleng: I'm free Tue 10am. I'll prepare demo notebook + perf graphs.

jonas_infra: Ops can support Wed morning for peering setup if we get CIDR tonight.

nina_security: SOC2 share ready in 48h pending CISO sign-off. NDA: legal already has template — @sam_sales can you send customer contact?

sam_sales: Sent contact (alice@sentinel.com). Uploaded draft capability matrix: sentinel-capability-matrix-v1.xlsx :file_attachment:

maya_soleng: Quick note — for reserved discounts, we should propose a pilot SKU: 'dedicated-2w-poc' with 20% discount conditional on later 12mo commit.

sam_sales: Good. I'll include that. Last ask: can we include a one-page appendix mapping their checkbox security questionnaire to our controls? @nina

nina_security: Yes. I'll produce mapping table and annotate gaps. ETA EOD.

sam_sales: Thanks all. I'll assemble final RFI response and send before 17:00 PST. :thumbsup:
